meta.title: Timer on Me - Multiple Timers & Stopwatches in One App
meta.description: Run multiple timers and stopwatches simultaneously. Interval training, home screen widgets, session management, and custom ringtones. Free for iPhone and iPad.
meta.keywords: timer, stopwatch, multiple timers, interval training, HIIT timer, Tabata, iOS app, home screen widget, countdown timer

hero.title: Multiple Timers, One App
hero.description: Run as many timers and stopwatches as you need, all at once. Perfect for cooking, workouts, studying, or anything that needs precise timing.

features.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to master your time

list.title: Multi-Timer Grid
list.description: Run multiple timers and stopwatches simultaneously in a clean, responsive grid. Each clock has independent controls—start, pause, and reset individually.

list.title: Interval Training
list.description: Built-in HIIT, Tabata, and custom interval presets. Create your own work/rest sequences for the perfect workout routine.

list.title: Home Screen Widgets
list.description: Control your timers right from your home screen. Small, medium, and large widget sizes to fit your layout.

list.title: Session Management
list.description: Save your timer setups and load them anytime. Export sessions as JSON, CSV, or text for easy sharing and backup.

list.title: Custom Ringtones
list.description: Choose from 7 built-in alarm sounds—from a simple bell to vintage phone rings. Alarms work even in Silent Mode with iOS 18.2+.

list.title: Smart Display
list.description: Centisecond precision, percentage progress, and a keep-screen-on mode. Customize how your timers look and behave.

download.title: Start Timing Now
download.description: Free to download. Multiple timers, interval training, and widgets—all ready to go. No account required.

privacy.title: Your Privacy Matters
privacy.description: Timer on Me stores all your data locally on your device. No accounts, no tracking, no data collection. Your timer sessions are yours alone.
